<div id="app">
<header><button class="b" id="bk" style="visibility:hidden">☰ Màn</button><h1>🖼️ Nonogram</h1><span id="lv"></span></header>
<section id="menu"><p id="sub"></p><div id="grid"></div><p class="hp">Số cạnh lưới cho biết độ dài các cụm ô liền nhau cần tô trong hàng/cột đó. Tô đúng hình để qua màn.</p></section>
<section id="play" hidden><div id="info"></div><div id="board"></div><div id="msg"></div><div id="ctl"></div></section>
<div id="md" hidden><div class="box"><h2 id="mt"></h2><p id="mx"></p><div id="mb"></div></div></div>
</div>
<script>
const GAME={key:'nonogram'};
const MAX=100,KEY='gp_'+GAME.key;
let prog=0,L=1,over=false;
try{prog=Math.min(MAX,+localStorage.getItem(KEY)||0)}catch(e){}
const qs=s=>document.querySelector(s);
const save=()=>{try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,prog)}catch(e){}};
const rng=s=>()=>{s|=0;s=s+0x6D2B79F5|0;let t=Math.imul(s^s>>>15,1|s);t=t+Math.imul(t^t>>>7,61|t)^t;return((t^t>>>14)>>>0)/4294967296};
const side=x=>Math.max(200,Math.min(innerWidth-20,innerHeight-215-(x||0),720));
const setInfo=h=>{qs('#info').innerHTML=h},say=t=>{qs('#msg').textContent=t||''};
const stop=()=>{if(typeof onStop=='function')onStop()};
function fitMenu(){const s=Math.max(240,Math.min(innerWidth-20,innerHeight-175,640)),g=qs('#grid');g.style.width=g.style.height=s+'px';g.style.fontSize=Math.max(11,s/10*.36)+'px'}
function menu(){
 stop();qs('#play').hidden=true;qs('#menu').hidden=false;qs('#md').hidden=true;
 qs('#bk').style.visibility='hidden';qs('#lv').textContent='';
 qs('#sub').textContent='Đã qua '+prog+'/'+MAX+' màn';
 let h='';for(let i=1;i<=MAX;i++)h+='<button class="'+(i<=prog?'done':i==prog+1?'cur':'lock')+'" data-l="'+i+'"'+(i>prog+1?' disabled':'')+'>'+i+'</button>';
 qs('#grid').innerHTML=h;fitMenu();
}
function play(l){
 stop();L=l;over=false;qs('#md').hidden=true;qs('#menu').hidden=true;qs('#play').hidden=false;
 qs('#bk').style.visibility='visible';qs('#lv').textContent='Màn '+l;
 const b=qs('#board');b.className='';b.removeAttribute('style');b.innerHTML='';b.onclick=b.onpointerdown=b.onpointermove=b.onpointerup=b.onpointercancel=null;
 qs('#ctl').innerHTML='';say('');setInfo('');start(l);
}
function modal(t,x,btns){qs('#mt').textContent=t;qs('#mx').textContent=x;const m=qs('#mb');m.innerHTML='';
 btns.forEach(a=>{const e=document.createElement('button');e.className='b '+(a[2]||'');e.textContent=a[0];e.onclick=a[1];m.appendChild(e)});qs('#md').hidden=false}
function win(x){if(over)return;over=true;if(L>prog){prog=L;save()}stop();
 setTimeout(()=>{if(!qs('#menu').hidden)return;const fin=L>=MAX,bt=[];if(!fin)bt.push(['Màn tiếp ▶',()=>play(L+1),'on']);bt.push(['Chơi lại',()=>play(L)],['Chọn màn',menu]);
  modal(fin?'🏆 Hoàn thành cả 100 màn!':'🎉 Qua màn '+L+'!',x||'',bt)},450)}
function fail(x){if(over)return;over=true;stop();modal('Chưa được',x||'',[['Thử lại',()=>play(L),'on'],['Chọn màn',menu]])}
qs('#grid').onclick=e=>{const b=e.target.closest('button');if(b&&!b.disabled)play(+b.dataset.l)};
qs('#bk').onclick=menu;
addEventListener('resize',()=>{if(!qs('#menu').hidden)fitMenu();else if(typeof relayout=='function')relayout()});

let n,rc,cc,st,mode,paint,drag,rEl,cEl,mr,mc;
function runs(a){const r=[];let k=0;for(const x of a){if(x==1)k++;else if(k){r.push(k);k=0}}if(k)r.push(k);return r}
function sl(cl,ln){
 const n=ln.length,A=Array(n).fill(1),O=Array(n).fill(0),cur=Array(n).fill(0);let ok=false;
 (function go(ci,pos){
  if(ci==cl.length){for(let i=pos;i<n;i++)if(ln[i]==1)return;for(let i=pos;i<n;i++)cur[i]=0;ok=true;for(let i=0;i<n;i++){A[i]&=cur[i];O[i]|=cur[i]}return}
  const k=cl[ci],rest=cl.slice(ci+1).reduce((a,b)=>a+b+1,0);
  for(let s=pos;s+k+rest<=n;s++){
   if(s>pos&&ln[s-1]==1)break;
   let g=true;for(let i=s;i<s+k;i++)if(ln[i]==0){g=false;break}
   if(!g)continue;
   if(s+k<n&&ln[s+k]==1)continue;
   for(let i=pos;i<s;i++)cur[i]=0;for(let i=s;i<s+k;i++)cur[i]=1;if(s+k<n)cur[s+k]=0;
   go(ci+1,Math.min(n,s+k+1))
  }
 })(0,0);
 if(!ok)return null;
 return ln.map((_,i)=>A[i]?1:O[i]?-1:0)
}
function unk(r,c,n){
 const g=Array(n*n).fill(-1);let ch=true;
 while(ch){ch=false;
  for(let y=0;y<n;y++){const ln=g.slice(y*n,y*n+n),t=sl(r[y],ln);if(!t)return 1e9;t.forEach((x,i)=>{if(x!=ln[i]){g[y*n+i]=x;ch=true}})}
  for(let x=0;x<n;x++){const ln=[];for(let y=0;y<n;y++)ln.push(g[y*n+x]);const t=sl(c[x],ln);if(!t)return 1e9;t.forEach((v,y)=>{if(v!=ln[y]){g[y*n+x]=v;ch=true}})}
 }
 return g.filter(v=>v<0).length
}
function start(l){
 n=Math.min(15,5+Math.floor((l-1)/8.5));const R=rng(l*104729+5);let best=null,bu=1e9;
 for(let t=0;t<(n>11?20:45);t++){
  const d=.5+R()*.12,p=Array.from({length:n*n},()=>R()<d?1:0),r=[],c=[];
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){r.push(runs(p.slice(i*n,i*n+n)));c.push(runs(p.filter((_,k)=>k%n==i)))}
  const u=unk(r,c,n);if(u<bu){bu=u;best={r,c}}if(u==0)break;
 }
 rc=best.r;cc=best.c;st=Array(n*n).fill(0);mode=1;drag=false;
 mr=Math.max(...rc.map(a=>a.length||1));mc=Math.max(...cc.map(a=>a.length||1));
 const b=qs('#board');b.className='ng';
 let h='<div></div>';
 for(let j=0;j<n;j++)h+='<div class="cl" data-c="'+j+'">'+(cc[j].length?cc[j]:[0]).map(k=>'<span>'+k+'</span>').join('')+'</div>';
 for(let i=0;i<n;i++){h+='<div class="rl" data-r="'+i+'">'+(rc[i].length?rc[i]:[0]).map(k=>'<span>'+k+'</span>').join('')+'</div>';
  for(let j=0;j<n;j++)h+='<div class="c'+(j%5==4&&j<n-1?' q':'')+(i%5==4&&i<n-1?' w':'')+'" data-i="'+(i*n+j)+'"></div>'}
 b.innerHTML=h;rEl=[...b.querySelectorAll('.rl')];cEl=[...b.querySelectorAll('.cl')];
 b.onpointerdown=e=>{const c=e.target.closest('.c');if(!c||over)return;b.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);const i=+c.dataset.i;paint=st[i]==mode?0:mode;drag=true;put(i)};
 b.onpointermove=e=>{if(!drag)return;const t=document.elementFromPoint(e.clientX,e.clientY),c=t&&t.closest&&t.closest('.c');if(c)put(+c.dataset.i)};
 b.onpointerup=b.onpointercancel=()=>{drag=false};
 qs('#ctl').innerHTML='<button class="b on" id="md1">⬛ Đang: TÔ ô</button><button class="b" id="cl1">🗑 Xoá hết</button>';
 qs('#ctl').onclick=e=>{const t=e.target.closest('button');if(!t)return;if(t.id=='md1'){mode=mode==1?2:1;t.textContent=mode==1?'⬛ Đang: TÔ ô':'✖ Đang: ĐÁNH DẤU trống';t.classList.toggle('on',mode==1)}else if(t.id=='cl1'&&!over){st.fill(0);draw()}};
 relayout();draw();say('Kéo ngón tay/chuột để tô nhiều ô. Số mờ đi = hàng/cột đó đã đủ.');
}
function put(i){if(st[i]!=paint&&!over){st[i]=paint;draw()}}
function relayout(){const b=qs('#board');if(!b.classList.contains('ng'))return;const k=.75,W=innerWidth-16,H=innerHeight-200,c=Math.floor(Math.max(14,Math.min(W/(n+k*mr),H/(n+k*mc),44)));
 b.style.gridTemplateColumns=(mr*c*k)+'px repeat('+n+','+c+'px)';b.style.gridTemplateRows=(mc*c*k)+'px repeat('+n+','+c+'px)';b.style.fontSize=Math.max(9,c*.5)+'px';b.style.width='max-content'}
function draw(){
 const cs=qs('#board').querySelectorAll('.c');
 cs.forEach((e,i)=>{e.classList.toggle('f',st[i]==1);e.textContent=st[i]==2?'×':''});
 let ok=true;
 for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const m=runs(st.slice(i*n,i*n+n).map(x=>x==1?1:0)).join()==rc[i].join();rEl[i].classList.toggle('ok',m);if(!m)ok=false}
 for(let j=0;j<n;j++){const m=runs(st.filter((_,k)=>k%n==j).map(x=>x==1?1:0)).join()==cc[j].join();cEl[j].classList.toggle('ok',m);if(!m)ok=false}
 setInfo('Lưới '+n+'×'+n+' · Đã tô: '+st.filter(x=>x==1).length);
 if(ok){drag=false;win('Hình đã khớp với tất cả gợi ý!')}
}

menu();
</script></body></html>
